days.title: Ancient Paths and Landmarks
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Slieve Mish Mountains
stops.detail: The city is located at the foot of an old road that leads south over the Slieve Mish Mountains.

stops.name: Scotia’s Grave
stops.detail: On this old path is a large boulder, sometimes called Scotia's Grave, which is said to be the burial place of the daughter of an Egyptian pharaoh.

stops.name: Tralee Castle
stops.detail: Anglo-Normans founded the city in the 13th century, which became a stronghold of the Earls of Desmond, who built Tralee Castle.

stops.name: Bahnhof von Tralee
stops.detail: The Tralee railway station is the terminus of a route from Dublin.
